title: Solver development: selected original numerical diagnostics
processing: Original PNG bytes, dimensions and scientific content preserved. No cropping, resampling, smoothing or generated curves.
status: Selected internal numerical checks, not external certification or a general accuracy guarantee.
context: Two figures from one uniform TEM pulse-source study, not independent experimental studies. A separately implemented numerical reference is not a measurement.

images.title: Comparing a pulse with a numerical reference
images.purpose: Does the calculated pulse follow the reference response?
images.caption: The electric pulse from the 3D calculation is overlaid with a separately implemented scalar reference. The lower panels retain the electric and magnetic reference errors.
images.scope: This checks the selected source, uniform lossless line, grid and observation window. Small remaining differences are visible, not removed.
images.alt: Uniform TEM pulse: calculated and independently implemented reference traces, with electric and magnetic error panels and the original development-only notice.

images.title: Checking returning waves
images.purpose: Can a returning pulse cross the source region while it is active?
images.caption: Separate incident, returning and combined calculations are compared in both directions. The lower panels show the remaining superposition difference throughout the saved interval.
images.scope: The combined response is actually calculated, not assembled from the separate curves. This checks the defined source conditions, not an arbitrary PCB layout.
images.alt: Returning TEM pulse crossing an active source in both directions, with returning and combined-minus-incident traces and raw superposition differences.
